performance_case.causal_mechanism: A short-horizon order-flow pattern is economically worth another 42 forward days only when the exact discovery bytes, mechanically selected tier and causal m+2/m+62 fills pass the already frozen fee, matched-control, drawdown, breadth and concentration gates. A deterministic prebuilt runner prevents outcome-aware implementation and route rescue after the 14-day result is visible.
performance_case.claim_boundary: A positive implementation proves only that one offline zero-argument Local runner can validate synthetic equivalents of the exact future handoff and positive interpretation, reconstruct the frozen candidate/control ledgers, recompute every result field and publish a create-once VETO_BEFORE_V4 or PERMIT_LATER_V4 artifact. It does not inspect or evaluate real R2 bytes, prove prediction, fees, PnL, drawdown, capacity, V4 readiness, candidate value, OOS, deployment or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future discovery veto may avoid spending on a route whose causal fee-adjusted ledger has worse drawdown than its matched control, but actual drawdown and false-negative risk remain MISSING_PROOF until the sealed 14-day package is lawfully evaluated.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Implementing this bounded four-file runner now consumes local engineering time but removes a known post-interpretation bottleneck and can save 42 future days plus source/adapter work when discovery economics fail. The frozen false-negative cost is that one 14-day regime may veto a route that could generalize; no gate is relaxed to reduce that risk.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The capability cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its performance value is reducing evidence-to-decision latency and preventing a gross predictive label from advancing when exact 30-bps-friction, matched-control, drawdown, breadth or concentration economics already fail on the same sealed discovery inventory.
